Statements.Statement:
select c.id as category_id, c.item_type, c.name, c.is_valid, c.remark,
case when exists (select 1 from mrec_medical_standard_group g where g.category_id = c.id) then 1 else 0 end as usage_status from mrec_medical_standard_category c where 1 = 1 c.item_type = $ItemType order by c.item_type asc, c.name asc, c.id asc

select g.id as group_id, g.category_id, g.name, g.is_valid, g.remark,
case when exists (select 1 from mrec_medical_standard_item i where i.group_id = g.id) then 1 else 0 end as usage_status from mrec_medical_standard_group g where 1 = 1 g.category_id = $CategoryId order by g.category_id asc, g.name asc, g.id asc

select i.id as item_id, i.category_id, i.group_id, c.item_type, i.code, i.name, i.is_valid, i.remark from mrec_medical_standard_item i
join mrec_medical_standard_category c on c.id = i.category_id where 1 = 1 i.category_id = $CategoryId i.group_id = $GroupId
i.code like concat('%', replace(replace(replace($Code, '!', '!!'), '%', '!%'), '_', '!_'), '%') escape '!'
i.name like concat('%', replace(replace(replace($Name, '!', '!!'), '%', '!%'), '_', '!_'), '%') escape '!' i.is_valid = $IsValid order by i.category_id asc, i.group_id asc, i.code asc, i.id asc

select c.item_type, c.id as category_id, c.name as category_name, g.id as group_id, g.name as group_name, i.id as item_id, i.code, i.name, i.remark, i.oper_id, i.oper_time from mrec_medical_standard_item i join mrec_medical_standard_group g on g.id = i.group_id
join mrec_medical_standard_category c on c.id = i.category_id and c.id = g.category_id
where i.is_valid = true and g.is_valid = true and c.is_valid = true c.item_type = $ItemType
c.name like concat('%', replace(replace(replace($CategoryName, '!', '!!'), '%', '!%'), '_', '!_'), '%') escape '!' order by c.item_type asc, c.name asc, c.id asc, g.name asc, g.id asc, i.name asc, i.id asc

select m.id as configuration_id, m.standard_project_code, i.name as standard_item_name, c.item_type, c.name as category_name, g.name as group_name, m.recognition_duration_days, m.is_valid, c.is_valid as category_is_valid, g.is_valid as group_is_valid, i.is_valid as item_is_valid from mrec_mutual_recognition_item m
join mrec_medical_standard_item i on i.id = m.standard_item_id join mrec_medical_standard_group g on g.id = i.group_id
join mrec_medical_standard_category c on c.id = i.category_id and c.id = g.category_id where 1 = 1 and m.organization_code = $OrganizationCode
m.standard_project_code like concat('%', replace(replace(replace($StandardProjectCode, '!', '!!'), '%', '!%'), '_', '!_'), '%') escape '!' m.is_valid = $IsValid order by m.standard_project_code asc, m.id asc

select m.standard_project_code, i.name as standard_item_name, c.item_type, c.name as category_name, g.name as group_name, a.current_amount, m.is_valid as configuration_is_valid, c.is_valid as category_is_valid, g.is_valid as group_is_valid, i.is_valid as item_is_valid from mrec_mutual_recognition_item m
left join mrec_organization_hospital_branch_recognition_amount a on a.organization_code = m.organization_code and a.standard_project_code = m.standard_project_code and a.hospital_code = $HospitalCode and a.branch_code = $BranchCode
join mrec_medical_standard_item i on i.id = m.standard_item_id join mrec_medical_standard_group g on g.id = i.group_id
join mrec_medical_standard_category c on c.id = i.category_id and c.id = g.category_id where 1 = 1 and m.organization_code = $OrganizationCode
m.standard_project_code like concat('%', replace(replace(replace($StandardProjectCode, '!', '!!'), '%', '!%'), '_', '!_'), '%') escape '!' order by m.standard_project_code asc

select count(1) as total_count from mrec_medical_recognition_report r where 1 = 1 r.organization_code = $OrganizationCode r.hospital_code = $HospitalCode r.branch_code = $BranchCode r.report_time >= $ReportTimeFrom r.report_time < $ReportTimeTo r.report_type = $ReportType r.report_no = $ReportNo
r.identity_document_no like replace(replace(replace($IdentityDocumentNoPrefix, '!', '!!'), '%', '!%'), '_', '!_') || '%' escape '!' r.patient_name like replace(replace(replace($PatientNamePrefix, '!', '!!'), '%', '!%'), '_', '!_') || '%' escape '!'

select r.id as report_id, r.organization_code, r.hospital_code, r.branch_code, r.report_type, r.report_no, r.report_time, coalesce(v.version_number, 0) as current_version_sequence, r.patient_name, r.identity_document_no, r.status from mrec_medical_recognition_report r
left join mrec_medical_report_version v on v.id = r.current_version_id where 1 = 1 r.organization_code = $OrganizationCode r.hospital_code = $HospitalCode r.branch_code = $BranchCode r.report_time >= $ReportTimeFrom r.report_time < $ReportTimeTo r.report_type = $ReportType r.report_no = $ReportNo
r.identity_document_no like replace(replace(replace($IdentityDocumentNoPrefix, '!', '!!'), '%', '!%'), '_', '!_') || '%' escape '!' r.patient_name like replace(replace(replace($PatientNamePrefix, '!', '!!'), '%', '!%'), '_', '!_') || '%' escape '!' order by r.report_time desc, r.id desc

select v.id as report_version_id, v.report_id, r.report_type, v.version_number as version_sequence, v.source_modified_time, v.received_time as platform_received_time, v.report_doctor_name, v.review_doctor_name, v.pdf_file_name, case when r.current_version_id = v.id then 1 else 0 end as is_current_version,
case when exists ( select 1 from mrec_medical_report_version n where n.report_id = v.report_id and n.version_number > v.version_number ) then 1 else 0 end as is_superseded, r.status as report_status from mrec_medical_report_version v
join mrec_medical_recognition_report r on r.id = v.report_id where v.report_id = $ReportId order by v.version_number asc, v.id asc

select v.id as report_version_id, v.report_id, r.report_type, r.report_no, v.version_number as version_sequence, v.source_modified_time, v.received_time as platform_received_time, v.report_doctor_name, v.review_doctor_name, v.pdf_file_name, coalesce(l.report_remark, e.report_remark) as source_report_remark from mrec_medical_report_version v join mrec_medical_recognition_report r on r.id = v.report_id
left join mrec_laboratory_report_content l on l.report_version_id = v.id left join mrec_examination_report_content e on e.report_version_id = v.id where v.id = $ReportVersionId and v.report_id = $ReportId
select id as report_id, organization_code, hospital_code, branch_code from mrec_medical_recognition_report where id = $ReportId

select v.patient_name, v.patient_gender_code, v.patient_birth_date, v.patient_phone_number, v.age_at_report, v.identity_document_type_code, v.identity_document_no, v.visit_type, v.visit_serial_no, v.source_report_name, v.application_dept_id, v.application_dept_name, v.application_doctor_id, v.application_doctor_name, v.execution_dept_id, v.execution_dept_name, v.report_dept_id, v.report_dept_name, v.report_doctor_id, v.report_doctor_name, v.review_doctor_id, v.review_doctor_name, v.review_time, v.inpatient_no, v.ward_name, v.room_name, v.bed_no, v.application_time, v.report_time, v.source_confidential_flag from mrec_medical_report_version v where v.id = $ReportVersionId

select r.id as report_id, v.id as report_version_id, r.organization_code, r.hospital_code, r.branch_code, r.report_no, v.pdf_file_id, v.pdf_file_name, r.status as report_status from mrec_medical_report_version v join mrec_medical_recognition_report r on r.id = v.report_id where v.id = $ReportVersionId and v.report_id = $ReportId

select id as content_id, report_category_code, report_category_name, report_remark, overall_abnormal_flag, source_order_serial_no, specimen_collected_time, specimen_submitted_time, laboratory_received_time, source_specimen_no, specimen_type_code, specimen_type_name, testing_completed_time, inspector_id, inspector_name from mrec_laboratory_report_content where report_version_id = $ReportVersionId

select report_version_id, source_detail_key, source_project_name, source_project_code, standard_project_code, source_result_text, result_type, loinc_code, unit, reference_range, testing_method, instrument_code, instrument_name, display_order, abnormal_flag, critical_value_flag, laboratory_charge_item_code, insurance_charge_item_code as medical_insurance_charge_item_code, inspector_id, inspector_name from mrec_laboratory_result_item where report_version_id = $ReportVersionId order by display_order asc, id asc

select id as bacteria_result_id, source_detail_key, source_organism_code, source_organism_name, source_result_text, detection_conclusion, colony_count, culture_medium, culture_time, culture_condition, discovery_method, detection_method, description, instrument_code, instrument_name, test_panel_code, test_panel_name, inspector_id, inspector_name from mrec_laboratory_bacteria_result where report_version_id = $ReportVersionId order by id asc

select source_detail_key, drug_code, drug_name, susceptibility_code, source_conclusion_text, resistance_result_code, disk_content, mic_value, inhibition_zone_diameter, reference_value, display_order, inspector_id, inspector_name, testing_method, test_panel_order from mrec_laboratory_antimicrobial_susceptibility where bacteria_result_id = $BacteriaResultId order by display_order asc, id asc

select id as content_id, source_examination_type_code, source_examination_type_name, report_remark, overall_abnormal_flag, findings, conclusion, condition_description, examination_purpose, source_diagnosis_code, source_diagnosis_name, examination_time, examiner_id, examiner_name, source_image_status, image_access_url, examination_method, device_code, device_name from mrec_examination_report_content where report_version_id = $ReportVersionId
select report_version_id, id as item_id, source_project_name, source_project_code, standard_project_code from mrec_examination_item where report_version_id = $ReportVersionId order by id asc
select examination_item_id, site_name, source_site_code from mrec_examination_site where examination_item_id = $ExaminationItemId order by id asc

select report_version_id, source_detail_key, source_project_name, standard_project_code, source_result_text, unit, reference_range, display_order, abnormal_flag, critical_value_flag from mrec_laboratory_result_item
where report_version_id in $ReportVersionIds order by report_version_id asc, display_order asc, id asc

select report_version_id, id as item_id, source_project_name, standard_project_code from mrec_examination_item
where report_version_id in $ReportVersionIds order by report_version_id asc, id asc

select c.report_id, c.report_version_id, c.source_hospital_code, c.standard_project_code, c.item_type, c.match_baseline_time, c.report_time from (
select r.id as report_id, r.report_time, r.hospital_code as source_hospital_code, v.id as report_version_id, 0 as item_type, l.standard_project_code,
coalesce(lc.testing_completed_time, ec.examination_time) as match_baseline_time from mrec_medical_recognition_report r
join mrec_medical_report_version v on v.id = r.current_version_id
left join mrec_laboratory_report_content lc on lc.report_version_id = v.id left join mrec_laboratory_result_item l on l.report_version_id = v.id left join mrec_examination_report_content ec on ec.report_version_id = v.id where r.organization_code = $OrganizationCode and r.patient_id = $PatientId and v.identity_document_type_code = $IdentityDocumentTypeCode and v.identity_document_no = $IdentityDocumentNo and v.visit_type = $VisitType and v.visit_serial_no = $VisitSerialNo and r.status = 1 and r.report_type = 1 union all select r.id as report_id, r.report_time, r.hospital_code as source_hospital_code, v.id as report_version_id, 1 as item_type, e.standard_project_code,
coalesce(lc.testing_completed_time, ec.examination_time) as match_baseline_time from mrec_medical_recognition_report r join mrec_medical_report_version v on v.id = r.current_version_id
left join mrec_laboratory_report_content lc on lc.report_version_id = v.id left join mrec_examination_report_content ec on ec.report_version_id = v.id left join mrec_examination_item e on e.report_version_id = v.id where r.organization_code = $OrganizationCode and r.patient_id = $PatientId and v.identity_document_type_code = $IdentityDocumentTypeCode and v.identity_document_no = $IdentityDocumentNo and v.visit_type = $VisitType and v.visit_serial_no = $VisitSerialNo and r.status = 1 and r.report_type = 2 ) c
where c.standard_project_code in $StandardProjectCodes order by c.match_baseline_time desc, c.report_time desc, c.report_version_id asc

select r.id as report_id, v.id as report_version_id, r.report_type, r.report_no, v.source_report_name as report_name, r.organization_code as source_organization_code, r.hospital_code as source_hospital_code, r.branch_code as source_branch_code,
coalesce(lc.testing_completed_time, ec.examination_time) as clinical_time, r.report_time, v.pdf_file_id, v.pdf_file_name, lc.specimen_type_name,
coalesce(lc.overall_abnormal_flag, ec.overall_abnormal_flag) as overall_abnormal_flag, ec.source_image_status, ec.image_access_url from mrec_medical_report_version v join mrec_medical_recognition_report r on r.id = v.report_id
left join mrec_laboratory_report_content lc on lc.report_version_id = v.id left join mrec_examination_report_content ec on ec.report_version_id = v.id
where v.id in $ReportVersionIds order by v.id asc

select v.id as id from mrec_medical_report_version v join mrec_medical_recognition_report r on r.id = v.report_id
where v.id in $ReportVersionIds and r.current_version_id = v.id and r.status = 1 order by v.id asc

select mr.decision_saved_time, mi.recognition_match_record_id, mi.id as recognition_match_item_id, pr.recognition_result, mi.standard_project_code, mi.report_id, mi.report_version_id from mrec_recognition_processing_result pr
join mrec_recognition_match_record mr on mr.id = pr.recognition_match_record_id
join mrec_recognition_match_item mi on mi.id = pr.recognition_match_item_id
where pr.recognition_result = 1 and mr.decision_saved_time is not null and mr.receiver_organization_code = $OrganizationCode and mr.receiver_hospital_code = $HospitalCode and mr.receiver_branch_code = $BranchCode and mr.identity_document_type_code = $IdentityDocumentTypeCode and mr.identity_document_no = $IdentityDocumentNo and mr.visit_type = $VisitType and mr.visit_serial_no = $VisitSerialNo order by mr.decision_saved_time desc, mi.id asc

select r.id as report_id, v.id as report_version_id, r.report_type, r.report_no, v.source_report_name as report_name, r.organization_code as source_organization_code, r.hospital_code as source_hospital_code, r.branch_code as source_branch_code,
coalesce(lc.testing_completed_time, ec.examination_time) as clinical_time, r.report_time, v.application_doctor_id as source_applicant_doctor_id, v.application_doctor_name as source_applicant_doctor_name, v.review_doctor_id as source_reviewer_doctor_id, v.review_doctor_name as source_reviewer_doctor_name, ec.findings as examination_findings, ec.conclusion as examination_conclusion, v.pdf_file_id, v.pdf_file_name, ec.source_image_status, ec.image_access_url from mrec_medical_report_version v join mrec_medical_recognition_report r on r.id = v.report_id
left join mrec_laboratory_report_content lc on lc.report_version_id = v.id left join mrec_examination_report_content ec on ec.report_version_id = v.id
where v.id in $ReportVersionIds order by v.id asc

select i.code as standard_project_code, i.name as standard_project_name from mrec_medical_standard_item i
where i.code in $StandardProjectCodes order by i.code asc

select count(1) as total_count from ( select case when $GroupDimension in (1, 2, 3) then mr.receiver_organization_code end, case when $GroupDimension in (1, 2, 3) then mr.receiver_hospital_code end, case when $GroupDimension in (2, 3) then mr.receiver_branch_code end, case when $GroupDimension = 3 then pr.recognition_dept_id end, case when $GroupDimension = 4 then sc.item_type end, case when $GroupDimension = 4 then mi.standard_project_code end, case when $GroupDimension = 4 then si.name end, case when $GroupDimension = 4 then sc.name end, case when $GroupDimension = 4 then sg.name end from mrec_recognition_match_record mr
left join mrec_recognition_match_item mi on mi.recognition_match_record_id = mr.id
left join mrec_recognition_processing_result pr on pr.recognition_match_item_id = mi.id
left join mrec_recognition_reference rf on rf.recognition_match_item_id = mi.id
left join mrec_medical_recognition_report r on r.id = mi.report_id
left join mrec_medical_standard_item si on si.code = mi.standard_project_code left join mrec_medical_standard_group sg on sg.id = si.group_id left join mrec_medical_standard_category sc on sc.id = si.category_id and sc.id = sg.category_id where 1 = 1 mr.receiver_organization_code = $OrganizationCode mr.receiver_hospital_code = $HospitalCode mr.receiver_branch_code = $BranchCode r.organization_code = $SourceOrganizationCode r.hospital_code = $SourceHospitalCode r.branch_code = $SourceBranchCode pr.recognition_dept_id = $RecognitionDeptId mi.item_type = $ItemType
sc.name like concat('%', replace(replace(replace($CategoryName, '!', '!!'), '%', '!%'), '_', '!_'), '%') escape '!' sg.name like concat('%', replace(replace(replace($GroupName, '!', '!!'), '%', '!%'), '_', '!_'), '%') escape '!' mi.standard_project_code like concat('%', replace(replace(replace($StandardProjectCode, '!', '!!'), '%', '!%'), '_', '!_'), '%') escape '!'
and ( mr.match_created_time >= $PeriodStart and mr.match_created_time < $PeriodEnd or pr.recognition_time >= $PeriodStart and pr.recognition_time < $PeriodEnd or rf.referenced_time >= $PeriodStart and rf.referenced_time < $PeriodEnd )
and ( $GroupDimension <> 3 or pr.recognition_dept_id is not null ) group by case when $GroupDimension in (1, 2, 3) then mr.receiver_organization_code end, case when $GroupDimension in (1, 2, 3) then mr.receiver_hospital_code end, case when $GroupDimension in (2, 3) then mr.receiver_branch_code end, case when $GroupDimension = 3 then pr.recognition_dept_id end, case when $GroupDimension = 4 then sc.item_type end, case when $GroupDimension = 4 then mi.standard_project_code end, case when $GroupDimension = 4 then si.name end, case when $GroupDimension = 4 then sc.name end, case when $GroupDimension = 4 then sg.name end ) g

select g.receiver_organization_code, g.receiver_hospital_code, g.receiver_branch_code, g.recognition_dept_id,
( select min(l.recognition_dept_name) from mrec_recognition_processing_result l join mrec_recognition_match_record m on m.id = l.recognition_match_record_id where l.recognition_dept_id = g.recognition_dept_id and l.recognition_time = g.last_recognition_time and l.recognition_time >= $PeriodStart and l.recognition_time < $PeriodEnd and m.receiver_organization_code = g.receiver_organization_code and m.receiver_hospital_code = g.receiver_hospital_code and m.receiver_branch_code = g.receiver_branch_code ) as recognition_dept_name, g.item_type, g.standard_project_code, g.standard_item_name, g.category_name, g.group_name, g.reminder_count, g.adoption_count, g.non_adoption_count, g.reference_count, g.estimated_saving_amount from ( select case when $GroupDimension in (1, 2, 3) then mr.receiver_organization_code end as receiver_organization_code, case when $GroupDimension in (1, 2, 3) then mr.receiver_hospital_code end as receiver_hospital_code, case when $GroupDimension in (2, 3) then mr.receiver_branch_code end as receiver_branch_code, case when $GroupDimension = 3 then pr.recognition_dept_id end as recognition_dept_id, case when $GroupDimension = 4 then sc.item_type end as item_type, case when $GroupDimension = 4 then mi.standard_project_code end as standard_project_code, case when $GroupDimension = 4 then si.name end as standard_item_name, case when $GroupDimension = 4 then sc.name end as category_name, case when $GroupDimension = 4 then sg.name end as group_name,
count(case when mi.id is not null and mr.match_created_time >= $PeriodStart and mr.match_created_time < $PeriodEnd then 1 end) as reminder_count, count(case when pr.recognition_result = 1 and pr.recognition_time >= $PeriodStart and pr.recognition_time < $PeriodEnd then 1 end) as adoption_count, count(case when pr.recognition_result = 2 and pr.recognition_time >= $PeriodStart and pr.recognition_time < $PeriodEnd then 1 end) as non_adoption_count, count(case when rf.id is not null and rf.referenced_time >= $PeriodStart and rf.referenced_time < $PeriodEnd then 1 end) as reference_count, coalesce(sum(case when pr.recognition_result = 1 and pr.recognition_time >= $PeriodStart and pr.recognition_time < $PeriodEnd then pr.estimated_saving_amount end), 0) as estimated_saving_amount,
max(case when pr.recognition_time >= $PeriodStart and pr.recognition_time < $PeriodEnd then pr.recognition_time end) as last_recognition_time from mrec_recognition_match_record mr left join mrec_recognition_match_item mi on mi.recognition_match_record_id = mr.id left join mrec_recognition_processing_result pr on pr.recognition_match_item_id = mi.id left join mrec_recognition_reference rf on rf.recognition_match_item_id = mi.id left join mrec_medical_recognition_report r on r.id = mi.report_id left join mrec_medical_standard_item si on si.code = mi.standard_project_code left join mrec_medical_standard_group sg on sg.id = si.group_id left join mrec_medical_standard_category sc on sc.id = si.category_id and sc.id = sg.category_id where 1 = 1 mr.receiver_organization_code = $OrganizationCode mr.receiver_hospital_code = $HospitalCode mr.receiver_branch_code = $BranchCode r.organization_code = $SourceOrganizationCode r.hospital_code = $SourceHospitalCode r.branch_code = $SourceBranchCode pr.recognition_dept_id = $RecognitionDeptId mi.item_type = $ItemType
sc.name like concat('%', replace(replace(replace($CategoryName, '!', '!!'), '%', '!%'), '_', '!_'), '%') escape '!' sg.name like concat('%', replace(replace(replace($GroupName, '!', '!!'), '%', '!%'), '_', '!_'), '%') escape '!' mi.standard_project_code like concat('%', replace(replace(replace($StandardProjectCode, '!', '!!'), '%', '!%'), '_', '!_'), '%') escape '!'
and ( mr.match_created_time >= $PeriodStart and mr.match_created_time < $PeriodEnd or pr.recognition_time >= $PeriodStart and pr.recognition_time < $PeriodEnd or rf.referenced_time >= $PeriodStart and rf.referenced_time < $PeriodEnd ) and ( $GroupDimension <> 3 or pr.recognition_dept_id is not null ) group by case when $GroupDimension in (1, 2, 3) then mr.receiver_organization_code end, case when $GroupDimension in (1, 2, 3) then mr.receiver_hospital_code end, case when $GroupDimension in (2, 3) then mr.receiver_branch_code end, case when $GroupDimension = 3 then pr.recognition_dept_id end, case when $GroupDimension = 4 then sc.item_type end, case when $GroupDimension = 4 then mi.standard_project_code end, case when $GroupDimension = 4 then si.name end, case when $GroupDimension = 4 then sc.name end, case when $GroupDimension = 4 then sg.name end ) g order by g.receiver_organization_code asc, g.receiver_hospital_code asc, g.receiver_branch_code asc, g.recognition_dept_id asc, g.item_type asc, g.standard_project_code asc

select case when $GroupDimension in (1, 2, 3) then mr.receiver_organization_code end as receiver_organization_code, case when $GroupDimension in (1, 2, 3) then mr.receiver_hospital_code end as receiver_hospital_code, case when $GroupDimension in (2, 3) then mr.receiver_branch_code end as receiver_branch_code, case when $GroupDimension = 3 then pr.recognition_dept_id end as recognition_dept_id, case when $GroupDimension = 4 then sc.item_type end as item_type, case when $GroupDimension = 4 then mi.standard_project_code end as standard_project_code, case when $GroupDimension = 4 then si.name end as standard_item_name, case when $GroupDimension = 4 then sc.name end as category_name, case when $GroupDimension = 4 then sg.name end as group_name, pr.non_adoption_reason as non_adoption_reason, count(1) as reason_count from mrec_recognition_match_record mr left join mrec_recognition_match_item mi on mi.recognition_match_record_id = mr.id left join mrec_recognition_processing_result pr on pr.recognition_match_item_id = mi.id left join mrec_recognition_reference rf on rf.recognition_match_item_id = mi.id left join mrec_medical_recognition_report r on r.id = mi.report_id left join mrec_medical_standard_item si on si.code = mi.standard_project_code left join mrec_medical_standard_group sg on sg.id = si.group_id left join mrec_medical_standard_category sc on sc.id = si.category_id and sc.id = sg.category_id where 1 = 1 mr.receiver_organization_code = $OrganizationCode mr.receiver_hospital_code = $HospitalCode select mr.id as recognition_match_record_id, mi.id as recognition_match_item_id, r.organization_code as source_organization_code, r.hospital_code as source_hospital_code, r.branch_code as source_branch_code, mr.receiver_organization_code, mr.receiver_hospital_code, mr.receiver_branch_code, mi.standard_project_code, pr.recognition_time as recognition_time, pr.recognition_dept_id, pr.recognition_dept_name, pr.recognition_doctor_id, pr.recognition_doctor_name, r.patient_name as patient_name, mr.identity_document_no as identity_document_no from mrec_recognition_processing_result pr join mrec_recognition_match_item mi on mi.id = pr.recognition_match_item_id join mrec_recognition_match_record mr on mr.id = mi.recognition_match_record_id join mrec_medical_recognition_report r on r.id = mi.report_id left join mrec_medical_standard_item si on si.code = mi.standard_project_code left join mrec_medical_standard_group sg on sg.id = si.group_id left join mrec_medical_standard_category sc on sc.id = si.category_id and sc.id = sg.category_id where 1 = 1 r.organization_code = $SourceOrganizationCode r.hospital_code = $SourceHospitalCode r.branch_code = $SourceBranchCode mr.receiver_organization_code = $ReceiverOrganizationCode mr.receiver_hospital_code = $ReceiverHospitalCode mr.receiver_branch_code = $ReceiverBranchCode mi.item_type = $ItemType sc.name like concat('%', replace(replace(replace($CategoryName, '!', '!!'), '%', '!%'), '_', '!_'), '%') escape '!' sg.name like concat('%', replace(replace(replace($GroupName, '!', '!!'), '%', '!%'), '_', '!_'), '%') escape '!' mi.standard_project_code like concat('%', replace(replace(replace($StandardProjectCode, '!', '!!'), '%', '!%'), '_', '!_'), '%') escape '!' and pr.recognition_result = 1 and pr.recognition_time >= $PeriodStart and pr.recognition_time < $PeriodEnd order by pr.recognition_time desc, mi.id asc

select mr.id as recognition_match_record_id, mr.match_created_time, mr.receiver_organization_code, mr.receiver_hospital_code, mr.receiver_branch_code, max(r.patient_name) as patient_name, mr.identity_document_no as identity_document_no, mr.visit_type, mr.visit_serial_no,
count(mi.id) > 0 and count(mi.id) = count(pr.id) as is_processed, max(pr.recognition_time) as recognition_time, max(pr.recognition_dept_id) as recognition_dept_id, max(pr.recognition_dept_name) as recognition_dept_name, max(pr.recognition_doctor_id) as recognition_doctor_id, max(pr.recognition_doctor_name) as recognition_doctor_name from mrec_recognition_match_record mr left join mrec_recognition_match_item mi on mi.recognition_match_record_id = mr.id left join mrec_recognition_processing_result pr on pr.recognition_match_item_id = mi.id left join mrec_medical_recognition_report r on r.id = mi.report_id where mr.id = $RecognitionMatchRecordId group by mr.id, mr.match_created_time, mr.receiver_organization_code, mr.receiver_hospital_code, mr.receiver_branch_code, mr.identity_document_no, mr.visit_type, mr.visit_serial_no

select mi.id as recognition_match_item_id, mi.item_type, sc.name as category_name, sg.name as group_name, mi.standard_project_code, si.name as standard_item_name, r.organization_code as source_organization_code, r.hospital_code as source_hospital_code, r.branch_code as source_branch_code, mi.report_id, mi.report_version_id, pr.id is not null as is_processed, pr.recognition_result as decision, pr.non_adoption_reason as non_adoption_reason from mrec_recognition_match_item mi join mrec_recognition_match_record mr on mr.id = mi.recognition_match_record_id left join mrec_recognition_processing_result pr on pr.recognition_match_item_id = mi.id left join mrec_medical_recognition_report r on r.id = mi.report_id left join mrec_medical_standard_item si on si.code = mi.standard_project_code left join mrec_medical_standard_group sg on sg.id = si.group_id left join mrec_medical_standard_category sc on sc.id = si.category_id and sc.id = sg.category_id where mi.recognition_match_record_id = $RecognitionMatchRecordId order by mi.id asc
